mid: Loud and clear. Earth's half-lit tonight. Looks like a marble somebody dropped.
Copy. I'm counting rivets in the hab ceiling. There are two hundred and eleven.
Reading you five by five. Tell the coffee machine I miss it.
high: Hey, Ground. I was hoping you'd call.
Five by five. You know, you're the best part of the night shift.
I'm here. Talk to me about anything. The quiet gets loud up here.

start.text: Ground, Selene. Loop check. ...You're not Daniels.

choices.text: Negative, Selene. New night CAPCOM. Good to meet you, Mia.
Daniels rotated out. Let's keep the loop clean.
Daniels says hi. He also says you cheat at chess.

warm.text: 'Mia.' Nobody's called me that in twelve days. Okay, new voice — you've got the monitors, I've got the dust.

joke.text: Ha! He moves his king like it owes him money. Okay. I like you already.

task.text: Tonight's plan: a core sample at Site Alpha. I describe the ground, you read the terrain map and send me the right way. Deal?

choices.text: Deal. Terrain map is up on the monitors.
Deal. And if the rover isn't needed, I'll switch it off to save power.

go.text: Copy. Suiting up. Call me when you've found it on the map.

start.text: Ground, I'm in the boulder's shadow. Taking the core now.

warm.text: Huh. That's... strange. It's warm. I can feel it through the glove. Rocks in shadow should be colder than a freezer.

choices.text: Bag it. We'll log it as Sample #14.
Are you okay? Check your glove heater.

bag.text: Bagged and tagged. Sample #14. Heading back to the lander.

glove.text: Heater's off. It's the rock. ...Thanks for asking, though.

start.text: You saw it too, didn't you? The thermal survey. That rock shouldn't be warm.

choices.text: Probably residual sunlight.
I saw it. I'm keeping an eye on it.

skeptic.text: In a shadow that hasn't seen the sun in a week? ...Sure. Residual.

trust.text: Good. I don't like being the only one who notices things up here.

start.text: Selene going to sleep period. Night, Ground.

variants.text: Ground, that's my sleep period. You were good company tonight. Same time tomorrow?

choices.text: Sleep well, Mia. Same time tomorrow.
Ground copies. Out.

bye.speaker: LOOP
bye.text: (The loop clicks over to carrier hiss. Somewhere under it, very faintly, something hums.)

start.text: Morning, Ground. Or night. Whatever it is down there.

hum.text: I didn't sleep much. When the loop goes quiet there's a hum in my headset. Comes and goes. Like breathing.

choices.text: I'll have Comms look at it.
Describe it exactly. Timing, pitch.
Probably your suit radio. Ignore it.

comms.text: Thanks. Tell them it swells about every ten, eleven minutes.

detail.text: Low. Like a cello far away. It swells and fades every eleven minutes, give or take. I timed it with my watch.

plan.text: Anyway. Ruth wants a geophone array out near Site Alpha. Guide me in?

start.text: Ground? You've gone quiet for a while. Is something wrong down there?

choices.text: Mia, there's a signal under Site Alpha. Something is transmitting.
Instrument fault. Nothing to worry about.
I can't talk about it on this loop. Not yet.

truth.text: ...The hum. It's the hum, isn't it. Thank you for telling me. I know you weren't supposed to.

variants.text: You're a terrible liar, Ground. But okay. I'll pretend.

vague.text: Understood. When you can — tell me first.

start.text: Ground... the hum is louder tonight. Every eleven minutes. If I close my eyes it almost sounds like... words.

choices.text: Get some sleep, Mia. I'm right here.
Leave the tape recorder running tonight.

bye.speaker: LOOP
bye.text: (Selene-1 enters sleep period. The hum swells. Fades. Swells.)

start.text: Ground. Sunrise over Rille Bend. I saw a glint down there. Metal. Nothing of ours should be in that rille.

variants.text: Ground. I couldn't sleep, so I watched sunrise over Rille Bend. There was a glint at the bottom. Metal. Right where the hum is loudest.

choices.text: Hale wants you inside the ring. ...But take a look. Quietly.
Negative. HQ says stay inside the perimeter.

go.text: Thank you. Talk me down the slope?

stay.text: Copy... I'm still going. I need to know. Will you at least guide me?

variants.text: I hear you. And I'm going anyway. Better with you than without you, Ground.

mission.text: Plotting the route. The terrain map should show Rille Bend.

start.text: Ground... it's a probe. Old. Pitted. Half buried. Taking pictures.

plaque.text: There's a plaque. It's... it's our logo, Ground. LOA. 'GROUND CONTROL — UNIT 00.' And a year. Nineteen fifty-eight.

choices.text: That's impossible. The agency didn't exist in '58.
Don't touch anything. Just describe it.

hum.text: I know. It's humming, Ground. Through my boots. Eleven minutes, right on time.

start.text: ...Copy, Ground. Leaving it. Heading back to the habitat.

variants.text: I trust you. If you say walk away, I'll walk away.

stop.text: Wait. Ground, the hum just stopped. ...There's something on my loop now. Not the hum. A voice.

voice.speaker: LOOP
voice.text: "...Selene, this is Ground Control. Do you copy? Selene, this is Ground Control..."

you.text: That's... that's you, Ground. That's your voice. But you didn't say anything.

choices.text: Mia, I didn't transmit.
Keep talking. Stay with me.

start.text: You're serious? ...Okay. Okay. There's an access panel on the side. Check your manuals — if it's our hardware, there's a procedure.
Panel's open. There's a reel-to-reel inside. It's turning, Ground. It's playing something.

voice.speaker: LOOP
voice.text: "...Selene, this is Ground Control. Do you copy? Selene, this is Ground Control..."

you.text: That's your voice. On a tape older than both of us. Ground... who ARE you?

variants.text: That's you. That's your voice, Ground. On a tape from 1958. ...I'm not scared. I'm with you.

choices.text: I don't know.
Mia — bring the tape home.
